oconus_pws_and_theater_clauses_text.description: Primary solicitation or contract input text for DoD OCONUS / INDOPACOM Deployment, SOFA, Defense Base Act (DBA) & SPOT Compliance API.
oconus_pws_and_theater_clauses_text.example: SOLICITATION FA5209-26-R-0038 (374th Contracting Squadron / USINDOPACOM C5ISR Network & Zero-Trust Operations): Places of Performance: Yokota AB & Kadena AB, Japan (12 FTEs); Camp Humphreys, Republic of Korea (8 FTEs); and Ramstein AB, Germany (6 FTEs). Clauses: FAR 52.228-3 (Workers' Compensation Insurance [Defense Base Act]), DFARS 252.225-7040 (Contractor Personnel Supporting U.S. Armed Forces Deployed Outside the United States), USFJ Instruction 64-100 (SOFA Article XIV Contractor Status), USFK Reg 700-19 (Invited Contractor / Technical Representative), and USEUCOM DOCPER TESA under NATO SOFA Article 72/73.
